description.title: About the Role
description.text: We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to join our Platform team. You will build user-facing components using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, and work on performance optimization and accessibility.

qualifications.title: What You'll Need
qualifications.text:
- 5+ years of React experience
- Strong TypeScript skills
- Experience with Next.js or similar frameworks
- Understanding of web performance and accessibility
